recommendation.thresholdSummary: Critical threshold crossed: Winter Storm Warning with icy, snow-covered roads
recommendation.explanation: A Winter Storm Warning runs through the whole workday. Freezing rain overnight left a glaze under 4 in of new snow, and MoDOT reports covered, icy pavement on I-35, I-70, and downtown arterials. 6.5 in of snow is forecast by evening, so neither the morning nor the evening commute can be made safely. A full closure is the supported posture; 51 telework-ready employees can keep working remotely.
recommendation.whatCouldChange: Snow totals dropping below 6 in with the warning ending before 7 AM and roads improving by 10 AM would support a delayed arrival.

alternatives.note: Leaves 9 on-site-only employees choosing between leave and a dangerous commute.
Not supported: snow continues through the workday.
Not supported: roads are covered and the warning is active.

alerts.headline: Mixed precipitation. Ice accumulations up to two tenths of an inch, then heavy snow with total accumulations of 5 to 8 inches. Travel will be very difficult to impossible for the morning commute.

roads.detail: Ice under snow-covered pavement on I-35, I-70, US-71, and downtown arterials near the office. Plows are working priority routes only.
